source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the components of the immune system (PDF 176-177).

blocks.text: Immune system jism mein kisi aik jagah mehdood nahin. Balke yeh bohat se alag alag cells se bana hai jo hamla awar microbes se larne ke liye infection ki jagah daurte hain. Yeh cells white blood cells (safaid khoon ke cells) hain jo bone marrow (haddi ke goode) mein bante hain aur khoon aur lymph mein gardish karte hain. Yeh lymph nodes, spleen (tilli), liver (jigar), thymus aur bone marrow mein bhi milte hain. White blood cells ki teen bari qismein hain: monocytes, T cells aur B cells. T aur B cells ko mila kar lymphocytes kehte hain.
